view: PA frontal (erect) chest radiograph; L marker on image right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate: good inspiration (about 9 posterior ribs), adequate penetration with spine visible behind heart, no significant rotation (clavicles roughly symmetric about spinous processes); both scapulae partially project over the upper lateral lung fields (more on the right); entire lung fields and costophrenic angles included.

devices.type: multiple metallic surgical clips (approximately 12), curvilinear arrangement, consistent with prior axillary lymph node dissection
devices.location: right axilla / right upper lateral chest wall soft tissues, projecting over and lateral to the right upper zone at the level of the 2nd-4th ribs

devices.type: external radiographic side marker ('L') with technologist label ('8H')
devices.location: over the left shoulder / left upper corner of the image (patient's left)

abnormalities.finding: Multiple (about 12) metallic surgical clips in curvilinear distribution in the axillary soft tissues, consistent with previous axillary lymph node dissection
Absent breast shadow with relative hyperlucency of the lower hemithorax compared with the left (left breast soft-tissue shadow present) - consistent with prior mastectomy; no parenchymal abnormality
Tortuous / unfolded thoracic aorta with prominent, rounded aortic knob (age-related; possible mild arch calcification)

description_zh: 站立後前位胸部X光，吸氣及曝光尚可，L標記位於影像右側，方向正常，無明顯旋轉。右側腋窩可見約十餘枚呈弧形排列之金屬手術夾，且右側乳房陰影消失、右下胸廓較左側相對透亮，符合右側乳房切除併腋窩淋巴結廓清術後變化；未見胸管、引流管或其他導管。兩側肺野清晰，未見實質化、結節、間質病灶或氣胸，兩側肋膈角銳利，無肋膜積液；心臟大小正常，胸主動脈迂曲、主動脈弓突出，屬年齡相關變化，氣管居中，橫膈輪廓平滑，胃泡位於左橫膈下正常位置，骨骼未見急性異常。
